summary: Czech family foundry (150 staff, EUR 8.3 M), we are 2.4 % of its turnover and growing 30 %. The new moulding line (Apr 2026) tied up more cash than planned: its bank tightened the credit line (Oct 2026) and is watching its figures, and it asks customers to pay within 10 days from November. Calls Hollerau an important reference customer. Holds only 25 % of Volute casing HI 80-250; 70180 has 75 % (at a higher 654.52). Quality slipping: ppm 5682, red Q3, porosity issue admitted. Trade 10-day payment and volume for price.
notes: Cash-short after the moulding-line start-up; bank tightened its credit line. Wants 10-day payment and volume for the new line; fears losing the 25 % share to 70180 and its bank. Admits a porosity issue. We pay 5.5 days late on average.

tactics: Open deep: it gave way fully in past renewals, we have 70180 at 75 %, and it needs cash now.
Offer payment within 10 days, as its letter asks, only in exchange for a price step.
Offer more quota from 70180 as binding volume for its new line in exchange for price.
Cite the red Q3 scorecard (5682 ppm) and its porosity issue as a separate argument.
playbook.expected_concession: No arena data; past renewals settled below even its own offers (kept share -0.16), and bank pressure makes cash terms worth a price step.
